figures.caption: The original milestones and current evidence status. Engineering completion does not imply causal or confirmatory qualification.
Computed retention results for Llama 8B. All fixed contrasts remain exploratory after the failed clean/arithmetic gate.
Matched computation, context and copy calibration. Root-format and context effects cannot alone identify whether arithmetic, routing or selection failed.
All fixed query-selectivity curves. The large queried/unqueried difference establishes decoder-specific accessibility on consumed structures, not disposal, ownership or natural causal use.
Corrected literal transfer. Use the corrected digit-boundary figure; the earlier figure is historical, not an alternative valid zero-effect result.
A common final cue shrinks the early/late timing gap. Query timing by itself therefore does not distinguish maintained state from reconstruction.
Discovery confidence increments with the corrected source comparison. Intervals condition on saved out-of-fold predictions and are not final unfamiliar-program validation.
Complementarity of the two saved confidence bundles across all fixed contexts; this does not revise the earlier alternative-bundle null result.
Corrected extra-query comparator. Additional observations and oracle access are distinct contracts, not free mechanistic features.
Relationship controls: include the stronger source-value pipeline and equal-state/different-provenance comparisons, not only weak direct text heads.
Two-model literal/computed results, transfer and generated behavior. The graphs use supplied node/scaffold identities; root formats also change arithmetic and token context.
Slot-complete current-definition/version/parent recovery. Whole-task rates require every head correct; they are not pooled per-slot accuracies.
Direct identity readouts and stronger source priors across every fixed layer. Parent recovery does not beat the stronger source comparator.
All fixed grammar comparisons. Read source-owner and owner-only controls alongside hidden joint scores.

New synthesis from the pinned saved reviews. Current/previous rates pool all three instructions and equality controls descriptively; primary reliability remains cell-by-cell. Optimistic ceiling credits every invalid answer while keeping already-valid integer answers unchanged.
